name: Mayor’s Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence  Resource Directory
description:
This dataset is a directory of 306 organizations and programs in New York City that provide services related to domestic and gender-based violence, compiled by the Mayor's Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence. Each row describes one resource, such as a police precinct domestic violence unit, a Safe Horizon office, a community center, or a supervised visitation program.

For each entry, the data includes the organization and program name, street address, borough, ZIP code, main phone number, fax, TTY number, website, and whether the physical address should be displayed. It also records hotline numbers and hours, general program hours, which boroughs are served, languages offered (including interpretation services and less common languages), wheelchair accessibility, and whether services carry a fee. Service details cover specialized populations served (for example, survivors of sexual assault, trafficking, or child abuse) and the types of services provided, such as crisis counseling, community education, court or police accompaniment, and general domestic violence support.
